stories.title: Catholic school closures in Flintshire move to 28-day objection period after Cabinet vote
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council’s Cabinet has voted to press on with plans to close four Catholic schools and build a £55m school in Flint for pupils aged three to 18. stories.title: Offices in China or flood defences in Broughton: the question put to the First Minister
stories.summary: The First Minister has defended Welsh Government spending on overseas offices after being asked how he could tell flooded residents in Flintshire the money was better spent abroad. stories.title: Health board wants alcohol harm considered before Flintshire pubs and shops get licences
stories.summary: North Wales’s health board wants Flintshire County Council to take an area’s deprivation and alcohol harm into account before licensing pubs, clubs and shops to sell alcohol. stories.title: ‘One big family’: Flintshire foster carers on the scheme no other Welsh council offers
stories.summary: Flintshire remains the only council in Wales running the Mockingbird fostering scheme, six years after introducing it, Foster Wales Flintshire said.
